entries.title: C0120 exact Gaussian ground-state scope
entries.statement: Scope definition for C0120: iid N(0,1) site weights on Z_+^2; n-vertex up/right paths from the origin with free endpoint; M_n is the maximum path sum including the origin. The attached 2008 source proves Var(M_n)<=C n/log n; the session asks for Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon) for some epsilon>0. Current openness UNKNOWN; no solution claim.

entries.title: Gaussian polymer gradient spectral identity (draft)
entries.statement: [DRAFT: author analytic proof; independent review pending.] For the exact Gaussian ground-state model, write a_k=||Proj_k(M_n-E M_n)||_2^2 in normalized Gaussian Hermite chaos. Then sum k a_k=n, Var(M_n)=sum a_k, and Q_n(t)=E|P(g) intersect P(g^t)|=sum k a_k exp(-(k-1)t).
assumptions: iid N(0,1) site weights on Z_+^2; n-vertex up/right paths from the origin with free endpoint; M_n is the maximum path sum including the origin.

entries.title: Polynomial spectral escape variance reduction (draft)
entries.statement: [DRAFT: conditional reduction; input unproved.] In the exact Gaussian ground-state model let D_n(K)=sum_{k<=K} k||Proj_k(M_n-E M_n)||_2^2. For integer K>=1, Var(M_n)<=D_n(K)+n/(K+1) and D_n(K)<=K Var(M_n). If a,b>0 and D_n(floor n^a)<=C n^(1-b) uniformly for large n, then Var(M_n)<=(C+1)n^(1-min(a,b)). A variance power epsilon gives D_n(floor n^(epsilon/2))<=C n^(1-epsilon/2).
assumptions: iid N(0,1) site weights on Z_+^2; n-vertex up/right paths from the origin with free endpoint; M_n is the maximum path sum including the origin.
All conditional bounds are uniform for sufficiently large n

entries.title: C0120 unproved polynomial spectral mass input
entries.statement: [UNPROVED INPUT G1.] For the exact Gaussian quadrant/free-endpoint maximum M_n, seek constants a,b>0,C,n_0<infinity such that sum_{k<=floor n^a} k||Proj_k(M_n-E M_n)||_2^2<=C n^(1-b) for every n>=n_0. The conditional reduction is proved by its author; this premise is not proved. The known n/log n variance estimate supplies only D_n(K)<=C K n/log n.
assumptions: iid N(0,1) site weights on Z_+^2; n-vertex up/right paths from the origin with free endpoint; M_n is the maximum path sum including the origin.

entries.title: Noise overlap to Hermite cutoff bridge (draft)
entries.statement: [DRAFT: author analytic proof; independent review pending.] In the exact Gaussian ground-state model and notation D_n(K),Q_n(t) above, for integer K>=1 and t>=0, Q_n(t)<=D_n(K)+n exp(-Kt), and D_n(K)<=exp((K-1)t)Q_n(t). These inequalities do not supply a polynomial decorrelation rate.
assumptions: iid N(0,1) site weights on Z_+^2; n-vertex up/right paths from the origin with free endpoint; M_n is the maximum path sum including the origin.
OU coupling and normalized Hermite chaos as in the spectral identity

entries.title: Small-influence power variance inference has a scope gap
entries.statement: [REFUTED GENERIC ROUTE; not a refutation of C0120.] Gaussianity, fixed path length n, squared gradient norm n, and nonroot vertex marginal influences at most 1/n do not alone imply a uniform O(n^(1-epsilon)) variance bound with any fixed epsilon>0 over arbitrary directed path families. Additional graph-specific information is needed.
assumptions: Path family on an arbitrary directed acyclic graph

entries.title: Parallel Gaussian corridors: logarithmic obstruction (draft)
entries.statement: [DRAFT: author analytic proof; independent review pending.] A common root with m disjoint corridors of n-1 vertices has maximum T=g_0+sqrt(n-1) max_{j<=m}G_j. For n>=2,m>=8, its squared gradient norm equals n and each nonroot influence is 1/m, while 1+c(n-1)/log(2m)<=Var(T)<=1+2(n-1)/log m with c=(1-exp(-exp(-3/2)*log(2)/10))/4>0. Setting m=n refutes the generic inference; the graph is not the C0120 quadrant lattice.
assumptions: Independent standard Gaussian site weights along disjoint corridors
Gaussian hypercontractivity for upper bound; elementary Mills bounds for lower bound

entries.title: C0120 source scope correction (draft)
entries.statement: [DRAFT SOURCE CORRECTION; independent statement review pending.] The C0120 citation arXiv:0810.4221v2 Section 8 and Section 12(3) concerns a zero-temperature Gaussian maximum in 1+1 dimensions with free endpoint. The intake and its two exported cards replace this by Var(log Z_n) in general dimension; that broader attribution is unsupported by the cited Theorem 8.1. Preserve their historical record and add the exact source scope.
assumptions: Scope comparison of named intake row and two exported C0120 cards
